answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11448 Country: India Title: Asalamoalaikum. Is it permissible to sell human bones for medical studies nd if not dn wht shud a person do wid the bones already present. Question: Asalamoalaikum. Is it permissible to sell human bones for medical studies nd if not dn wht shud a person do wid the bones already present. Answer ID: 11448 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 364/333=B/1430) Human being is respectable with all his body parts, as Allah says: ? And We bestowed dignity on the children of Adam.? (17:70) Therefore, selling the human bones are unlawful, the bones should be buried in graveyard after digging a pit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
